description.en:
Asks the match to switch into event mode (to play a scene in the middle of a match) or back out of it. It only posts the request; the match carries it out over the next frames, waiting for its screen transitions, then clears the request. Wait for that with CMND_BTL_IS_FINISH_ACTEV.

Switching in reconfigures the match scene for the event; several of those display changes depend on the second argument, which says whether the event uses the top screen. Switching out restores the match scene.
The ev_main helpers StartScEvent and EndScEvent wrap it: they call it with 1 or 0, then wait until CMND_BTL_IS_FINISH_ACTEV() is true.
1 (any non-zero value) to enter event mode, 0 to leave it.
Non-zero if the event is shown on the top screen (StartScEvent passes its _is_upper argument).

true once the request is posted.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Entering event mode at the start of an in-match scene (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, StartScEvent)
Leaving event mode at the end of the scene (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, EndScEvent)
